name: 4G Activation
description: Experimental targeted request: one 0x51:0x1A wlm_service_mode_switch_req frame asking the ground WLM for liveview HYBRID mode on the aircraft with the given serial. Write completion does not prove 4G activation; the request is refused (resp 3,3,3) while the WLM has not seen LTE availability (no beacon/pairing yet).
note: Payload of the single frame (cmd_set 0x51, cmd_id 0x1A = 26) is: {ver=00, service_type=00 (SERVICE_LIVEVIEW), mode=01 (LIVEVIEW_HYBIRD)} + ASCII aircraft serial as the target-SN string. Serial is read at runtime via probeSerial(). The old 128-frame sweep with prefix 000000 was a no-op: mode byte 00 = LIVEVIEW_SDR, and 46 of the IDs have no handler at all.
